question.maltese: Liema mezz ta' trasport tuża kuljum?

answer.maltese: Għax huwa mgħaġġel u l-vjaġġ huwa sabiħ.
Rari nuża t-taxi, imma nużah meta għandi bżonn nasal malajr.

items.english: Every day many people take the bus.
Sometimes I go on foot.
I rarely use a taxi.
He goes to work by car.
My sister goes by bicycle.
When we go to Gozo, we take the ferry.

items.maltese: Bl-ajruplan immorru minn pajjiż għal ieħor.
items.english: By airplane we go from one country to another.

items.maltese: Bil-mixi huwa tajjeb għal triq qasira.
items.english: Walking is good for a short route.
By taxi you arrive comfortably.

items.maltese: Jekk inti Tas-Sliema, tista' tmur il-Belt bil-ferry.
items.english: If you are in Sliema, you can go to Valletta by ferry.

items.maltese: Il-ferry jitlaq ta' spiss matul il-jum.
items.english: The ferry leaves often during the day.

items.maltese: Eżempju ta' l-ewwel ferry huwa fis-06:45 mit-Tnejn sas-Sibt.
items.english: An example of the first ferry is at 06:45 from Monday to Saturday.
The ferry trip is short.
The trip takes about fifteen minutes.

items.maltese: Tista' wkoll taqbad bit-tal-linja minn Tas-Sliema.
items.english: You can also take the bus from Sliema.

items.maltese: Bħala eżempju, ir-rotta 15 għandha tluq fil-05:30, 06:00 u 06:30.
items.english: As an example, route 15 has departures at 05:30, 06:00 and 06:30.

items.maltese: Bit-tal-linja l-vjaġġ jista' jieħu bejn għoxrin u tletin minuta.
items.english: By bus the trip can take between twenty and thirty minutes.

items.maltese: Xi kultant jieħu aktar minħabba t-traffiku.
items.english: Sometimes it takes longer because of traffic.
By car you go around the harbour.
By car the problem can be parking.
By bicycle the trip is longer than the ferry.

items.maltese: Imma bir-rota hija għażla sabiħa meta t-temp ikun tajjeb.
items.english: But by bicycle it is a nice choice when the weather is good.

items.maltese: Jien inħobb il-ferry għax nara l-baħar.
items.english: I like the ferry because I see the sea.
From the ferry you see a beautiful view of the harbour.

items.maltese: It-taxi hija tajba meta għandi bagalja.
items.english: A taxi is good when I have luggage.

items.maltese: Meta għandi ftit ħin, nuża t-taxi.
items.english: When I have little time, I use the taxi.

items.maltese: Jekk it-triq hija qasira, nista' nimxi.
items.english: If the route is short, I can walk.

items.maltese: Għal din it-triq minn Tas-Sliema għall-Belt, il-ferry huwa l-aktar prattiku.
items.english: For this route from Sliema to Valletta, the ferry is the most practical.
Dear Maya,
Dear colleagues,
Warm greetings from Rome!
The weather is nice and it's sunny.
Best wishes to you,
See you all next week!

question.maltese: Ikteb kartolina lil ħabiba minn Ruma.
question.english: Write a postcard to a friend from Rome.

answer.maltese: Għażiża Maya, tislijiet sbieħ minn Ruma! It-temp sabiħ u llum rajna l-Kolossew. Għada se nimxu fiċ-ċentru. Inselli għalik, Elena.
answer.english: Dear Maya, warm greetings from Rome! The weather is lovely and today we saw the Colosseum. Tomorrow we'll walk around the city centre. Best wishes, Elena.

question.maltese: Ikteb kartolina lill-kollegi tiegħek minn Pariġi.
question.english: Write a postcard to your colleagues from Paris.

answer.maltese: Għeżież kollegi, tislijiet minn Pariġi! Hawn kiesaħ. Ilbieraħ żorna mużew. Narawkom fl-uffiċċju l-ġimgħa d-dieħla! Tislijiet, David.
answer.english: Dear colleagues, greetings from Paris! It's cold here. Yesterday we visited a museum. See you at the office next week! Best wishes, David.

question.maltese: Ikteb kartolina dwar il-vjaġġ lil ħabiba.
question.english: Write a postcard about the journey to a friend.

answer.maltese: Għażiża Maya, tislijiet minn Malta! Illum mort sal-port bil-mixi u rajt il-baħar. Narak dalwaqt! Elena.
answer.english: Dear Maya, greetings from Malta! Today I walked to the harbour and saw the sea. See you soon! Elena.

question.maltese: Ikteb kartolina dwar l-istess vjaġġ lill-kollegi tiegħek.
question.english: Write a postcard about the same journey to your colleagues.

answer.maltese: Għeżież kollegi, tislijiet minn Malta! Illum mort sal-port bil-mixi u rajt il-baħar. Narawkom dalwaqt! Elena.
answer.english: Dear colleagues, greetings from Malta! Today I walked to the harbour and saw the sea. See you all soon! Elena.
